subject: mathematics
concept: Finding a missing dimension when volume and two dimensions are known
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student adjusts a virtual cuboid's height until the total cube count matches a target volume
exercise.pictorial: Student works backward from a pictured cuboid's volume and two known dimensions

misconception_flags: divides volume by only one known dimension instead of both
